attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Physical Therapy (DHHS Division of Public Health, Licensure Unit)

rules.accepted_credit_types: No Board pre-approval; activities must relate to physical therapy (research, treatment, documentation, management or education); 1 hour = 60 minutes of attendance. State/national meetings and formal courses; home study with test max 10 h; management courses max 4 h; webinars max 10 h; research paper reviews max 5 h; publications max 10 h; Nebraska jurisprudence (NE LAW) exam with scaled score 600+ = 5 h; Nebraska Law Tutorial at 100% = 1 h; ABPTRFE residency/fellowship 1 h per month; initial CSCS certification 4 h; APTA-credentialed clinical instructor 1 h per 160 h (max 8 h PT); current healthcare-provider CPR certificate 2 h; presentations max 4 h. Not accepted: business, medical terminology, lay courses, courses under 60 minutes, on-the-job training, orientation or staff meetings.
rules.notes: All PT and PTA licenses expire November 1 of each odd-numbered year; CE must be completed in the preceding 24 months (November 2 - November 1). No mandatory topics; the Nebraska Law Tutorial is no longer required for renewal. Rule text effective 06/20/2020.
rules.rule_quote: On or before November 1 of each odd-numbered year, individuals holding an active license in the State of Nebraska must complete at least 20 hours of acceptable continuing education for a physical therapist and 10 hours of acceptable continuing education for a physical therapist assistant during the preceding 24-month period.
